exposure: Professional status (Family Medicine resident, Family Medicine Obstetrics fellow, Family Medicine Obstetrics fellowship alumni)
outcome: Intention or practice in rural locations
Intention or practice in medically underserved areas (MUA)
Pregnancy care intentions or practice (including low-risk, high-risk, and cesarean deliveries, and advanced obstetrics)
cohort: The study participants included 25 Family Medicine residents, 7 Family Medicine Obstetrics fellows, and 37 Family Medicine Obstetrics fellowship alumni who completed practice intentions or actual practice surveys.
finding: Family Medicine Obstetrics fellows and alumni intended or provided more extensive pregnancy-related care, including diverse delivery types, compared to Family Medicine residents, though residents and fellows showed higher intention to practice in medically underserved areas than alumni.
mod_finding: Fellows and alumni respectively intended and provided cesarean deliveries at higher rates than resident intentions.
